say:1:1620867001:1.text: One day, I'll slaughter them all—ow, ow, ow!
say:1:1620867001:1.source_cn: 该死的魔物！总有一天我一定要把它们全部杀死——啊痛痛痛！

say:2:1620867002:1.text: Can you just lie down and stop bragging?
say:2:1620867002:1.source_cn: 行了行了，你快歇歇吧，别在这里放大话了。

say:3:1620867003:1.text: The Hypofiends just won't stop coming... If this keeps up, we're done for.
say:3:1620867003:1.source_cn: 魔物一波又一波地来……哎，再这样，日子真要过不下去了。

say:4:1620867004:1.text: Don't lose heart! The mayor's brought in some great help this time! They could actually get rid of the monsters for good.
say:4:1620867004:1.source_cn: 别总说丧气话！镇长这次请来的那些冒险者不是挺厉害的吗？...

say:5:1620867005:1.text: I admire your optimism, but this isn't the first time help has come. We're still the ones left suffering, while they simply pocket our money and walk away.
say:5:1620867005:1.source_cn: 你倒是乐观……你数数看，镇子里都来了多少冒险者了？我们...

say:6:1620867006:1.text: They were outright scammers who did nothing! And the problem just keeps <style="highlight">getting worse</style>!
say:6:1620867006:1.source_cn: 我看这帮外来者压根就是骗子！委托费赚了不少，事情一样没...

say:7:1620867007:1.text: Hausburg was once a safe haven.
say:7:1620867007:1.source_cn: 过去大家一直说豪斯镇是这附近最安全的地方，很少有魔物出没。

say:8:1620867008:1.text: But now, the Hypofiends just <style="highlight">won't leave us alone</style>, even though there are other villages nearby!
say:8:1620867008:1.source_cn: 但现在魔物像是发了疯似的，明明周围还有其他的村镇，可它...

say:9:1620867009:1.text: Could it be that there's something wrong with Hausburg?
say:9:1620867009:1.source_cn: 难道真是豪斯镇有问题？

say:10:1620867010:1.text: I hear the guard captain got a scholar to check things out. Not sure if they've figured anything out yet...
say:10:1620867010:1.source_cn: 听说警卫队长找了个学者，正忙着调查呢。也不知道结果到底...

say:11:1620867011:1.text: Either way, it's not something ordinary folks like us need to worry about. Better to relax and enjoy the feast while the monsters are kept at bay.
say:11:1620867011:1.source_cn: 你急又有什么用？还不如趁魔物暂时被打退，好好去庆功宴上...
